Zanskar Moto-Passage: The Monolith Circuit

Manali — Sissu — Gonbo Rangjon — Phuktal Gompa — Jispa

About This Trip

Embark on an exhilarating high-altitude adventure into the heart of the raw and mystical Zanskar Valley. Starting from Manali, this 4-day motorcycle expedition takes you through the world-famous Atal Tunnel, across the towering Shinku La Pass (16,580 ft), and deep into one of the most remote corners of the Himalayas. On this journey, you'll ride past the legendary monolith peak of Gonbo Rangjon—revered as the sacred mountain of Zanskar—and trek to the breathtaking cliffside Phuktal Monastery, built directly into a massive natural cave. Designed for thrill-seekers and culture enthusiasts alike, this route blends rugged mountain passes, serene Himalayan valleys, and rich Tibetan Buddhist heritage into an unforgettable motorcycling circuit.

Itinerary

Board the evening Volvo / private transport from Delhi and travel overnight to Manali.

Arrive in Manali, collect bikes, and ride through the Atal Tunnel into Lahaul Valley via Sissu to Jispa.

Conquer Shinku La Pass (16,580 ft) entring Zanskar and camp near the sacred monolith peak of Gonbo Rangjon.

Ride toward Purne, trek to the cliffside Phuktal Cave Monastery, and return over Shinku La Pass to Jispa.

Ride back through Lahaul Valley and Atal Tunnel to Manali; board the evening Volvo back to Delhi.

Arrive back in Delhi early morning with unforgettable Himalayan memories.
